title: 3 Things Smart Money Does Before CPI (That Beginners Ignore)
description: CPI drops this week and most traders will get wrecked. Here are 3 things the R2F Trading system watches before high-impact news — so you're positioned like smart money, not caught off guard. Follow r2ftrading.com for daily ICT setups.
script: CPI hits this week. Most traders will blow up. Three things smart money does that beginners completely ignore. Number one. They mark buyside AND sellside liquidity before the release. Price needs fuel to move. Those resting stops are the fuel. Number two. They wait for the liquidity sweep. CPI candles hunt stops first — then reverse. Every single time. Don't chase the spike. Number three. They enter on the fair value gap left behind after the sweep. That imbalance is the real entry. Not the news candle itself. I blew two funded accounts trading news the wrong way. Same setup, wrong timing. The sweep changes everything. Miss it — you're the exit liquidity. This week: mark your levels Sunday. Let CPI sweep liquidity. Enter the FVG.
